inlines.v: STAR-SHOOT, noun [star and shoot.] That which is emitted from a star. I have seen a good quantity of that jelly, by the vulgar called a star-shoot as if it remained upon the extinction of a falling star. [The writer once saw the same kind of substance from a brilliant meteor, at Amherst in Massachusetts. See Journ. Of Science for a description of it by Rufus Graves, Esq.]
